callouts.title: 估计的基本思路
callouts.body: 因为被积对象的分子具有周期性，在$[0,\pi]$内的积分会走过很多个周期，于是考虑通过换元得到在$[0,(N+\frac{1}{2})\pi]$上的积分，然分拆积分。(思路可以参考[[分段估计#2. 可数分段]])最后把不完整的周期分离出去，整个渐进问题就是估计一个不完整的周期，以及在一个周期里面做渐进。

classification_result.id: Dirichlet核不是逼近单位,Fejer核是逼近单位元#2

if_strategy_template.summary_en: When the numerator of the integrand is periodic, use a change of variables so the integral runs over many periods, then split the interval into complete periods plus one incomplete remainder. Reduce the asymptotic estimate to bounding the incomplete period and analyzing the contribution of one full period.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies to asymptotic estimates of oscillatory or periodic integrals where periodic structure can be exploited by rescaling and interval decomposition.

callouts.id: Dirichlet核不是逼近单位,Fejer核是逼近单位元#3
callouts.title: 例子2.1
callouts.body: $a_n:=(-1)^n$，那么其部分和$$S_n:=\begin{cases}1&n\text{是偶数}\\0&n\text{是奇数}\end{cases}$$是不存在极限的。但是这个序列确实Cesaro可和的，因为$$\sigma_N:=\frac{S_0+\cdots+S_{N-1}}{N}=\frac{\lfloor\frac{N}{2}+1\rfloor}{N}$$其极限为$\frac{1}{2}$。

classification_result.id: Dirichlet核不是逼近单位,Fejer核是逼近单位元#3

if_problem.statement_en: Let $a_n:=(-1)^n$. Then its partial sums are $$S_n:=\begin{cases}1&n\text{ is even}\\0&n\text{ is odd}\end{cases}$$ so $S_n$ does not converge. However, this sequence is Cesaro summable, because $$\sigma_N:=\frac{S_0+\cdots+S_{N-1}}{N}=\frac{\lfloor\frac{N}{2}+1\rfloor}{N}$$ and its limit is $\frac{1}{2}$.

callouts.id: Dirichlet核不是逼近单位,Fejer核是逼近单位元#4
callouts.title: 定理2.2
callouts.body: $$F_N(x):=\frac{1}{N}\frac{\sin^2(Nx/2)}{\sin^2(x/2)}$$并且这是一个$L^1([-\pi,\pi])$上的逼近单位元。

classification_result.id: Dirichlet核不是逼近单位,Fejer核是逼近单位元#4

if_problem.statement_en: $$F_N(x):=\frac{1}{N}\frac{\sin^2(Nx/2)}{\sin^2(x/2)}$$ and this is an approximate identity in $L^1([-\pi,\pi])$.

callouts.id: Dirichlet核不是逼近单位,Fejer核是逼近单位元#5
callouts.title: 推论2.3
callouts.body: 如果函数$f$是单位圆周$\mathbb{T}$上的可积函数，并且其傅里叶系数满足$$\widehat{f}(n)=0,\forall n\in \mathbb{Z}$$那么在$f$的任意连续点处都为取值为0。

classification_result.id: Dirichlet核不是逼近单位,Fejer核是逼近单位元#5

if_problem.statement_en: If $f$ is an integrable function on the unit circle $\mathbb{T}$ and its Fourier coefficients satisfy $$\widehat{f}(n)=0,\forall n\in \mathbb{Z},$$ then at every point where $f$ is continuous, its value is $0$.
prerequisites: Fejer kernel as an approximate identity

callouts.id: Dirichlet核不是逼近单位,Fejer核是逼近单位元#6
callouts.title: 推论2.4
callouts.body: 假设$f \in C(\mathbb{T}\to \mathbb{C})$，并且其对应的傅里叶系数形成的级数绝对收敛，即$$\sum_{n\in \mathbb{Z}}|\widehat{f}(n)|<\infty$$那么函数的傅里叶级数的部分和一致收敛到函数本身。

classification_result.id: Dirichlet核不是逼近单位,Fejer核是逼近单位元#6

if_problem.statement_en: Assume $f \in C(\mathbb{T}\to \mathbb{C})$, and the series of its Fourier coefficients converges absolutely, that is, $$\sum_{n\in \mathbb{Z}}|\widehat{f}(n)|<\infty.$$ Then the partial sums of the Fourier series of $f$ converge uniformly to $f$ itself.

callouts.id: Dirichlet核不是逼近单位,Fejer核是逼近单位元#7
callouts.title: 推论2.5
callouts.body: 如果$f \in C(\mathbb{T}\to \mathbb{C})$那么可以被$\mathbb{T}$上的多项式一致逼近。

classification_result.id: Dirichlet核不是逼近单位,Fejer核是逼近单位元#7

if_problem.statement_en: If $f \in C(\mathbb{T}\to \mathbb{C})$, then $f$ can be uniformly approximated by polynomials on $\mathbb{T}$.
